sophia (partnerships): Quick sync: NovaEdge wants a compact perf/W validation next Tue 10am PT to compare our patched memcpy against their stock kernel. Partner will supply board power traces. Can we limit artifact sharing to aggregated CSVs and a short hotspots list?

dan (eng-performance): We should run three scenarios: cold start, warmed KV cache, and heavy batching. I can set `--agg-hotspots=5` and produce `metrics_summary.csv` and `hotspots.tsv` (ids only). What's the target power cap?

ira (kernel-team): We'll provide patched-kernel-v2. We won't share kallsyms. We'll export top stacks as anonymized ids with `hotspot_id`. Also will include `kernel_build_id` (no hostnames).

novaedge-eng: We can provide wall-power at 100ms and SoC telemetry (freq/temp). Our parser expects `ts_ms,power_w,soc_temp_c,gpu_freq_mhz`. We'll need `run_id` in all files.

leo (bench-ops): I'll reserve rack and PDUs 9:30-11:00 PT and attach power meter. Bench-bot will tag artifacts with `run_id=novaedge-2026-04-07-1` and upload to s3://redwood-partner-exchange/novaedge/. I'll redact hostnames from metadata.txt.

dan (eng-performance): Proposed command:

```
./run_bench --model=gpt-j-small --seq=1024 --batch=6 --runs=3 \ 
  --kernel=patched-kernel-v2 --agg-hotspots=5 \ 
  --export-power=power_<run_id>.csv --export-agg=metrics_<run_id>.csv \ 
  --limit-watts=150
```

ira (kernel-team): Counters we'll export (aggregated per 10s): `L2_MISS,memcpy_bytes,ipc,gpu_idle_pct`. No raw perf.data.

novaedge-eng: That works. We'll also provide a short mapping file for our `hotspot_id` if deeper triage is agreed and NDA allows. For this smoke, anonymized ids are fine.

sophia (partnerships): Action list:
- leo: bench orchestration + s3 upload + run_id
- dan: update runbook with command and sample CSVs
- ira: push telemetry contract (headers only) to GH
- novaedge-eng: confirm CSV headers and provide read-only S3 creds

bench-bot: Pre-run checks complete. Rack-13 reserved. Will post summary (throughput, avg power, hotspots list) after completion. :robot_face:
